content:
I can see you're working hard on your Warrior One, and you've got a good foundation going. Let me help you refine your alignment to get the most benefit from this powerful pose.

First, let's focus on your spine. I notice it's not quite straight right now. Imagine a string pulling you up from the crown of your head, lengthening through your entire torso. Draw your tailbone slightly down while lifting your chest up and forward. This will help create that beautiful long line through your spine that we're looking for.

Now, let's bring attention to your arms. I'd like to see them reaching straight up toward the ceiling. Right now they're not fully extended. Think about energizing all the way through your fingertips, as if you're trying to touch the sky. Keep your arms parallel to each other, right beside your ears if possible. This full extension will help open your chest and create that lovely line of energy from your fingertips all the way down through your grounded feet.

Finally, check your front knee position. Your knee needs to be directly over your ankle - this is really important for protecting your joint. If you look down, you want to be able to see your big toe. Adjust your stance length if needed. You might need to step your feet a bit further apart or bend a little deeper into the lunge to get that 90-degree angle with your knee stacked right over your ankle.

You're doing great! These adjustments will help you feel stronger and more stable in the pose. Take a deep breath and feel the warrior strength building within you.
